description: This file is a code-behind class for an ASP.NET page 'ShowAns.aspx', which retrieves and displays answers and marks for a student in an online examination system. It handles page load to fetch answers from a database and updates marks based on user input.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for ShowAns.aspx page, handling the display of student's answers and marks, and submitting updated marks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event to retrieve answers from the database for questions 1 through 5 based on session-stored student and course IDs.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminPanel.aspx page when home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminQueue.aspx page when profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminLeaderboard.aspx page when leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles submission of updated marks, updates the database, deletes student's course queue entry, and navigates to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
